CITY  OF SOUTH  GATE
  REGULAR  CITY  COUNCIL  MEETING
  MINUTES
  TUESDAY,  NOVEMBER  25, 2025

CALL  TO ORDER  Maria  Davila,  Mayor  called  a Regular  City  Council  Meeting  to order at
  7:00 p.m.

INVOCATION  Tina De La Rosa, Deputy  Director  of Parks

PLEDGEOFALLEGIANCE  RomanArnador,PoliceCaptain

ROLL  CALL  Yodit  Glaze,  City  Clerk

PRESENT  Mayor  Maria  Davila,  Vice  Mayor  Joshua Barron,  Council  Member  Maria
  del Pilar Avalos,  Council  Member  Gil Hurtado  and Council  Member  Al
  Rios;  City  Treasurer  Jose De La Paz, City  Manager  Rob Houston,  City
  Attomey  Raul F. Salinas

RECOGNITION  The City  Council  unanimously  recognized  Retiring  Director  of Parks &
  Recreation,  Steve Costley.

PRESENTATION  The City  Council  unanimously  received  and filed  the Public  Works  and
  Community  Development  Departments  tracking  plan projects
  presentation.

PRESENT  ATION  The City  Council  unanimously  received  and filed  information  about how
  the Utility  Users Tax (UUT)  Works  presentation.

RECESS  The City  Council  recessed  at 9:23 p.m.,  and reconvened  at 9:25 p.m., with
  all Members  of Council  present.

  Gabriel  Perez, Director  of Cornrnunity  Development,  stated the city  is

  losing  a senior  member  of the Community  Development  team, Rodrigo

  Luis  Frausto,  Director  of Administrative  Services,  nothing  to report.

  Jon Hamilton,  Director  of Human  Services,  nothing  to report.

  Manny  Arana,  Police  Chief,  nothing  to report.

  Rob Houston,  City  Manager,  responded  to comments  about the budget  and

  the people  he works  with  in this city are very dedicated  and  care  about this

  community.

  Mr. Houston  apologized  and stated the agreements  for the AYSO  and

  JAA's  will  be sent out. Mr. Dominguez'  concern  about  not having  access

  to city staff and that it is not his job. He stated that it is his job to avoid  a

  hostile workplace  for the public servants. City staff and public servants  are

  not in the same  category  as elected officials.

  Raul F. Salinas,  City Attorney,  concurred  with  City  Manager.  Local
  governments  have an obligation  to protect  their  employees  from

  harassment  even from  members  of the public.  He appreciates  Liz Ruiz

  comments.  Her comments  are always  well  thought  out, very detailed.  It's

  unfortunate  that a member  of the public  has chosen  to misinterpret  his

  exchange  with  Ms. Ruiz.  His job as City Attorney  is to advise  city

  commissioners  and city council  when there are matters  of public  hearings.

REPORTS  AND  COMMENTS
FROM  CITY  OFFICLALS

CONT'D  Jose De La Paz, City  Treasurer,  stated last week he met with  City  Manager
  and went over the quarterly  budget  update.  This item will  be coming
  before  City  Council  in January.  He wished  everyone  a Happy
  Thanksgiving

  Yodit  Glaze,  City  Clerk,  wished  everyone  a Happy  Thanksgiving.

  Maria  Davila,  Mayor,  stated that for the past two weeks  she has been busy
  participating  in different  food distributions.  She attended  the SELA
  Kiwanis  installation  on Friday.  She specifically  thanked  all the nonprofits,
  businesses,  Senator  Lena Gonzalez,  and Assembly  Member  Jose Solache
  that participated  in the turkey  giveaways.  She thanked  city staff for their
  work.  She wished  everyone  a Happy  Thanksgiving.  The Family  Day at the
  Park was well  attended  and happy  it was held in the auditorium  due to the
  weather.

  Council  MemberAvalos  thanked  the YMCA  for funding  and organizing
  the one thousand  turkey  giveaway  including  pies. She thanked  Assembly
  Member  Solache  for partnering  up with  the YMCA.  She thanked  the food
  bank who donated  boxes  of produce.  She acknowledged  the South  Gate
  staff that were out there patrolling  and guiding  all the cars. She wished
  everyone  a Happy  Thanksgiving.  The Family  Day at the Park was well
  attended.

  Council  Member  Hurtado  stated receiving  a notification  that lights  were
  out in Hollydale,  but a concern  was raised that the streetlights  were
  reported  to staff via emails  and a response  was not received.  It is important
  to respond  to the request  by either  email  or phone.  The Family  Day at the
  Park was well  attended  and happy  it was held in the auditorium  due to the
  weather.  He thanked  everyone  that participated  in the turkey  giveaway.  He
  wished  a belated  happy  birthday  to Councilwoman  Avalos.  He also wished
  City  Treasurer  Jose De La Paz happy  birthday.  He wished  everyone  a
  Happy  Thanksgiving

  Council  Member  Rios thanked  the Cortez  family  for their participation
  withAYSO.  He thanked  everyone  for their  contribution  towards  giving
  away turkeys.  He is sadden by the way the immigrant  community  are
  being  treated.

  Council  Member  Hurtado  will  be forwarding  an email  to city manager
  regarding  LAUSD  resolution  that's  been asked for the city to consider.

  Vice Mayor  Barron  is grateful  to the Police  Department,  Parks &
  Recreation  Department  and city  staff for having  The Family  Day at the
  Park in the auditorium  due to the weather.  On the same day, the Kiwanis
  had their  Kiwanis  Day of Service  and received  a last-minute  call needing
